result.reason: The operative language meets the fallback and substantially tracks the preferred position: annual frequency, 30 days’ notice, business-hours inspection, an independent confidential auditor, and Vendor-paid costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%. However, it does not expressly prohibit direct access to Company systems, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. It also unnecessarily creates a reciprocal audit right and adds a post-termination audit period, materially altering unrelated rights beyond what the playbook requires. The drafting is otherwise professional. The margin comment is inaccurate because the original clause already limited scope to records reasonably related to payment calculations, and reciprocity is not a playbook requirement.
